title: Marketplace Orders Returns Centre Deduction Rates and Seller-Fault Reasons
content:
These are the deduction figures the Marketplace Orders returns process uses for each delivery option: the late-return deduction rate, the return shipping fee for returns whose reason is not a seller-fault reason, the two restocking rates, the list of seller-fault return reasons, and the rounding applied to every computed refund component and deduction.

| Delivery option | Late-return deduction rate | Remorse return shipping fee (USD per return) | Restocking rate, opened but resellable | Restocking rate, used, incomplete or damaged by the buyer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | 0.2 (20%) | 7.99 | 0.15 (15%) | 0.5 (50%) |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | 0.2 (20%) | 7.99 | 0.15 (15%) | 0.5 (50%) |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | 0.2 (20%) | 0.00 | 0.0 (0%) | 0.5 (50%) |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | 0.2 (20%) | 0.00 | 0.0 (0%) | 0.5 (50%) |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | 0.2 (20%) | 0.00 | 0.0 (0%) | 0.5 (50%) |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | not applicable | 149.00 | 0.15 (15%) | 0.5 (50%) |

Rates are shares of the item price of the returned units. The late-return deduction rate is not applicable on Large Item Freight Delivery because that option has no late grace period.

**Seller-fault return reasons (every option):** defective, damaged in transit, wrong item, not as described, missing parts. A return for one of these reasons is treated as the seller's fault: no return shipping fee, no restocking fee, and the original shipping refunded.

**Refund rounding (every option):** half up to the cent, applied to every computed refund component and deduction.

## Hypothetical reading

On a hypothetical return of one unit priced USD 80.00 on Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping, arriving opened but resellable, for a reason that is not a seller-fault reason, the restocking rate is 15% (USD 12.00) and the return shipping fee is USD 7.99. The same return on Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day carries a 0% opened rate and a USD 0.00 return shipping fee. The price and condition are example inputs only.
